Meet Ray a couple of weeks ago when he came to have a look at a job I needed putting right he measured up and sent a quote the same day.
Turned up when he said he would completed the first part of the job in no time and to a high standard.
However the second part of the job wich was new skirting board turned out not to be so straightforward.
He ripped out the old plastic skirting and revealed loads of wiring all around the room and the skirting i ordered had no rebate.
Ray just said the job is more difficult but don't worry i will sort it and he did he done a great job had to pay out a little bit more for extra materials but that's not his fault he got the job done correctly and we were very pleased.
A polite guy who we will be using again and would not hesitate to recommend him.
